syllabus_version.title: CBSE Curriculum for the Academic Year 2026-27

topics.title: Resources: meaning and classification
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Types of Resources

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what makes something in the environment a resource and why resources are a function of human activities.
Classify resources by origin, exhaustibility, ownership and status of development.

topics.title: Development of resources and sustainable development
topics.ncert_sections: Development of Resources; Sustainable Development; Rio Earth Summit; Agenda 21

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the problems caused by indiscriminate use of resources and the need for resource planning.
Explain the meaning of sustainable development and apply it to real situations.
Describe the Rio de Janeiro Earth Summit of 1992 and the objectives of Agenda 21.

topics.title: Resource planning and conservation
topics.ncert_sections: Resource Planning; Resource Planning in India; Conservation of Resources

concepts.learning_objective: State the steps involved in resource planning in India.
Analyse why availability of resources alone does not ensure development of a region.
Trace the ideas and milestones in resource conservation from Gandhiji to the Earth Summit.

topics.title: Land resources and land use pattern
topics.ncert_sections: Land Resources; Land Utilisation; Land Use Pattern in India

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the share of plains, mountains and plateaus in India's land area and their uses.
Distinguish between the categories of land use such as fallow land, culturable waste land, net sown area and gross cropped area.
Interpret the land use pattern of India and the physical and human factors behind it.

topics.title: Land degradation and conservation measures
topics.ncert_sections: Land Degradation and Conservation Measures

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the human activities that cause land degradation in different states of India.
Suggest suitable measures to check land degradation in arid, industrial and mining areas.

topics.title: Soil as a resource and classification of soils
topics.ncert_sections: Soil as a Resource; Classification of Soils

concepts.learning_objective: State the factors and processes responsible for the formation of soil.
Describe the distribution, properties and crops of alluvial and black soils.
Compare red and yellow, laterite, arid and forest soils in terms of formation and properties.

topics.title: Soil erosion and soil conservation
topics.ncert_sections: Soil Erosion and Soil Conservation

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the causes and types of soil erosion such as gully, sheet and wind erosion.
Choose suitable soil conservation methods such as contour ploughing, terracing, strip cropping and shelter belts.

topics.title: Biodiversity and flora and fauna in India
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Flora and Fauna in India

concepts.learning_objective: Explain biodiversity as varied wild and cultivated species linked through a network of interdependencies of which humans are a part.
State why forests play a key role in the ecological system as primary producers.
Describe India's rich biological diversity and why it is under stress.

topics.title: Conservation and the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972
topics.ncert_sections: Conservation of Forest and Wildlife in India

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why conservation of forests and wildlife preserves ecological and genetic diversity and life support systems.
State the provisions and thrust of the Indian Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
Explain the shift of conservation towards biodiversity, including insects and plants in protected lists.

topics.title: Project Tiger and tiger reserves
topics.ncert_sections: Project Tiger

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the threats that reduced India's tiger population and why India and Nepal were targeted by poachers.
State when Project Tiger was launched and why tiger conservation also preserves large biotypes.
Identify the tiger reserves of India named in the chapter and their states.

topics.title: Types and distribution of forest and wildlife resources
topics.ncert_sections: Types and Distribution of Forest and Wildlife Resources

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish reserved, protected and unclassed forests.
Explain permanent forest estates and their purpose.
Identify states with large shares of reserved, protected and unclassed forests.

topics.title: Community and conservation
topics.ncert_sections: Community and Conservation

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how local communities such as those of Sariska and Alwar protect habitats and wildlife.
Explain the contribution of the Chipko movement, Beej Bachao Andolan and Navdanya.
Explain how joint forest management involves local institutions and what benefits they receive.

topics.title: Sacred groves and traditional conservation
topics.ncert_sections: Sacred groves - a wealth of diverse and rare species

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how nature worship has preserved virgin forests as sacred groves.
Identify trees and animals protected by communities such as the Mundas, Santhals and Bishnois.

topics.title: Water as a renewable resource
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the hydrological cycle makes water a renewable resource.
Identify the sources and limited share of usable freshwater on the earth.

topics.title: Water scarcity and its causes
topics.ncert_sections: Water Scarcity and the Need for Water Conservation and Management

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how a large population and irrigated agriculture cause over-exploitation of water.
Describe how industries and growing cities add pressure on freshwater resources.
Explain how pollution can cause water scarcity even where water is ample.

topics.title: Need for water conservation and government initiatives
topics.ncert_sections: Water Scarcity and the Need for Water Conservation and Management

concepts.learning_objective: State why conserving and managing water resources is the need of the hour.
Recall the goal of the Jal Jeevan Mission for rural households.
Describe the coverage and key aim of the Atal Bhujal Yojana.

topics.title: Hydraulic structures and multi-purpose river projects
topics.ncert_sections: Multi-Purpose River Projects and Integrated Water Resources Management

concepts.learning_objective: Identify hydraulic structures built in ancient and medieval India.
Define a dam and classify dams by structure, materials and height.
Explain why dams are called multi-purpose projects and why they were seen as vital for development.

topics.title: Opposition to multi-purpose projects
topics.ncert_sections: Multi-Purpose River Projects and Integrated Water Resources Management

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse the ecological problems caused by damming and regulating rivers.
Explain how irrigation has changed cropping patterns and their consequences.
Describe how multi-purpose projects give rise to inter-state water disputes.

topics.title: Traditional rainwater harvesting
topics.ncert_sections: Rainwater Harvesting

concepts.learning_objective: Match traditional water harvesting methods with the regions where they were used.
Describe how rooftop rainwater was stored in tankas in arid Rajasthan.

topics.title: Modern adaptations of rainwater harvesting
topics.ncert_sections: Rainwater Harvesting; Bamboo Drip Irrigation System

concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate the present status of rooftop rainwater harvesting in different parts of India.
Interpret the rooftop rainwater harvesting model of Gendathur village.
Describe the bamboo drip irrigation system of Meghalaya.

topics.title: Types of farming
topics.ncert_sections: Types of Farming

concepts.learning_objective: Describe primitive subsistence (slash and burn) farming and its regional names in India.
Explain where and why intensive subsistence farming is practised.
Explain the features of commercial and plantation farming and why plantations need transport networks.

topics.title: Cropping seasons
topics.ncert_sections: Cropping Pattern

concepts.learning_objective: State the sowing and harvesting periods of rabi crops and the factors that help them succeed.
Identify kharif crops and the regions where paddy is grown in more than one season.
Identify the zaid season and the crops grown in it.

topics.title: Major food grains: rice, wheat, millets, maize and pulses
topics.ncert_sections: Major Crops: Rice, Wheat, Millets, Maize, Pulses

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the geographical conditions and main growing areas of rice and wheat.
Describe the conditions, nutritional value and producing states of jowar, bajra, ragi and maize.
Explain the importance of pulses and their role in restoring soil fertility.

topics.title: Food crops other than grains
topics.ncert_sections: Food Crops other than Grains: Sugarcane, Oil Seeds, Tea, Coffee, Horticulture Crops

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the conditions for sugarcane and the seasons and uses of the main oilseeds.
Describe the conditions needed for tea and the origin and areas of Indian coffee.
Relate India's tropical and temperate fruits and vegetables to the regions that produce them.

topics.title: Non-food crops: rubber and fibre crops
topics.ncert_sections: Non-Food Crops: Rubber, Fibre Crops, Cotton, Jute

concepts.learning_objective: State the climatic conditions and main growing areas of rubber.
Compare the geographical conditions required for cotton and jute.
Define sericulture and identify the four major fibre crops of India.

topics.title: Technological and institutional reforms
topics.ncert_sections: Technological and Institutional Reforms; Bhoodan - Gramdan

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the land reforms after Independence and the outcomes of the Green and White Revolutions.
Explain how schemes such as crop insurance, KCC and minimum support prices help farmers.
Describe the Bhoodan-Gramdan movement started by Vinoba Bhave.

topics.title: What is a mineral
topics.ncert_sections: What is a mineral?; Study of minerals by geographers and geologists

concepts.learning_objective: Define a mineral and explain how minerals make up rocks.
Explain why minerals vary in their properties and distinguish how geographers and geologists study them.

topics.title: Mode of occurrence of minerals
topics.ncert_sections: Mode of occurrence of minerals

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how minerals occur as veins and lodes in igneous and metamorphic rocks.
Explain how minerals form in sedimentary beds, by evaporation and as residual deposits.
Describe placer deposits and the minerals obtained from ocean waters and ocean beds.

topics.title: Ferrous minerals: iron ore and manganese
topics.ncert_sections: Ferrous minerals; Iron ore; Manganese

concepts.learning_objective: Compare magnetite and hematite in terms of iron content and use.
Identify the major iron ore belts of India, their mines and export ports.
State the uses of manganese and its role in steel making.

topics.title: Non-ferrous, non-metallic and rock minerals
topics.ncert_sections: Non-ferrous minerals; Copper; Bauxite; Non-metallic minerals; Rock minerals

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the uses and distribution of copper and bauxite in India.
Explain the properties, uses and distribution of mica.
State the occurrence and uses of limestone.

topics.title: Hazards of mining and conservation of minerals
topics.ncert_sections: Hazards of mining; Conservation of minerals

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the impact of mining on the health of miners and on the environment.
Explain why mineral resources must be conserved and suggest ways of doing so.

topics.title: Conventional sources of energy
topics.ncert_sections: Energy resources; Conventional sources of energy

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish the types of coal and describe the distribution of coal in India.
Explain the occurrence, uses and distribution of petroleum and natural gas in India.
Distinguish between hydroelectricity and thermal electricity.

topics.title: Non-conventional sources and conservation of energy
topics.ncert_sections: Non-conventional sources of energy; Conservation of energy resources

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how nuclear and solar energy are obtained and where their resources are found in India.
Explain how wind, tidal, geothermal energy and biogas are harnessed and where in India.
Evaluate the need for and ways of conserving energy resources.

topics.title: Manufacturing and its importance
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Importance of Manufacturing

concepts.learning_objective: Define manufacturing and place manufacturing workers in the secondary sector.
Explain why manufacturing is the backbone of economic development.
Explain how agriculture and industry move hand in hand.

topics.title: Classification of industries
topics.ncert_sections: Classification of Industries

concepts.learning_objective: Classify industries by source of raw material and by their main role.
Distinguish public, private, joint and cooperative sector industries.
Classify industries by bulk of materials and by capital investment.

topics.title: Agro-based industries: textiles and sugar
topics.ncert_sections: Agro-based Industries; Textile Industry; Cotton Textiles; Jute Textiles; Sugar Industry

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the importance and organisation of the cotton textile industry.
Explain the history and location factors of the jute industry in the Hugli basin.
Explain the location and recent shift of the sugar industry.

topics.title: Mineral-based industries: iron and steel, aluminium
topics.ncert_sections: Mineral-based Industries; Iron and Steel Industry; Aluminium Smelting

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the raw materials and location of the iron and steel industry.
Describe the properties of aluminium and the location factors of smelters.

topics.title: Chemical, fertilizer and cement industries
topics.ncert_sections: Chemical Industries; Fertilizer Industry; Cement Industry

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish inorganic and organic chemical industries and their location.
Describe the types of fertilizers produced and the spread of the industry.
State the raw materials, uses and location of the cement industry.

topics.title: Automobile and IT-electronics industries
topics.ncert_sections: Automobile Industry; Information Technology and Electronics Industry

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the growth and centres of the automobile industry.
Identify the centres and impact of the IT and electronics industry.

topics.title: Industrial pollution and environmental degradation
topics.ncert_sections: Industrial Pollution and Environmental Degradation

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the causes and effects of industrial air and noise pollution.
Explain how industries pollute water and land, including thermal pollution.

topics.title: Control of environmental degradation
topics.ncert_sections: Control of Environmental Degradation; NTPC shows the way

concepts.learning_objective: Describe ways to reduce industrial pollution of fresh water.
Identify measures to control industrial air and noise pollution.
Evaluate measures that integrate economic development with environmental concerns.

topics.title: Transport as a lifeline and roadways

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why efficient transport and communication are prerequisites for development and trade.
State the reasons for the growing importance of road transport compared with rail.
Classify Indian roads by capacity and identify projects such as the Golden Quadrilateral and PMGSY.
Describe the role of the Indian Railways in the national economy and integration.
Explain how physiographic, economic and administrative factors shape the railway network.
Interpret the gauge-wise distribution of India's railway route length.
Explain the uses, costs and advantages of pipeline transport.
Identify the three important pipeline networks of India and the places they connect.
Identify India's National Waterways and the merits of water transport.
Describe the location and specialisation of India's major sea ports.
Explain the advantages of air transport and schemes such as UDAN and Pawan Hans services.
Describe India's postal network and telecom facilities.
Identify the means and agencies of mass communication in India.
Define international trade and calculate and interpret the balance of trade.
Identify the main commodities exported from and imported to India.
Explain the role of tourism as a trade and the schemes that promote it.
